thread:
sarah: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's outage - streaming/chat partial responses + reconnects. I captured initial action items below; need owners/timelines so we can move to triage board.

sarah: Action items I have so far:
- (A) Client reconnect policy: make exponential backoff + jitter mandatory and stop double-connecting during transient errors -> owner?
- (B) Server keepalive/idle timeout tuning on the gateway to reduce partial-response hangs -> owner?
- (C) Add a regression test that simulates mid-stream drop + reconnect -> owner?
- (D) Dashboard/alert: count of partial responses per minute + % reconnections within 30s -> owner?
- (E) Postmortem doc: link + ETA for public follow-up notes

ken: I can take (A) client reconnect policy. I'll open a PR with code + unit tests. Target: 2 weeks. :+1:

lucas: I'll own (B) gateway timeouts and look at keepalive window. Plan: adjust default idle_timeout from 60s -> 20s and validate with canary. Will run load tests. Target: end of next sprint (10 business days).

priya: I'll do (D) dashboards/alerts. I'll add a Grafana panel and set an alert when partial_response_rate > 0.5% for 5m. Also will add an SLO to Redwood Console for streaming success rate. ETA: 5 business days.

ken: quick note on (A) — proposed client pseudocode for reconnect:
```python
# exponential backoff + jitter
for attempt in range(1, max_attempts+1):
    wait = min(base * 2**(attempt-1), max_backoff)
    wait *= random.uniform(0.5, 1.5)
    await asyncio.sleep(wait)
    try:
        await connect()
        break
    except TransientError:
        continue
```
Also will add detection to avoid duplicate connections (guard by connection-token).

lucas: Server-side: will add an explicit streaming session state with last-heatbeat timestamp and force-close after 30s of no activity. Also logging change: emit `stream_session_terminated` with reason code.

oncall-bot: Incident #2026 status changed -> postmortem_in_progress by sarah. Autogenerated timeline uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026

priya: For (C) tests, suggestion: use the chaos harness to drop tcp mid-stream and assert reconnect resumes and dedupe. Will pair with qa for flakiness runs.

sarah: Good. Need owners to add items to the 'incidents' triage board and put the ETA as labels. @ken @lucas @priya ack if you added them.

ken: Added (A) -> board ticket T1234, ETA label 2w, linked the PR template.

lucas: Added (B) -> T1235, set canary target and performance checklist.

priya: Added (C+D) -> T1236, combined tests + dashboards, ETA 5d.

sarah: Two follow-ups before we close: 1) Are there any recurring incident patterns we should track long-term? 2) Any quick mitigations we can prod deploy this week?

lucas: Pattern: spikes in partial responses align with long-lived idle connections from some SDK versions; we should roll out a server-side enforcement to limit session ttl to 6h and nudge clients. Quick mitigation: enable keepalive on gateway and lower idle timeout -> small prod roll within 48h.

ken: Quick mitigation from client-side: release patch that defaults to robust backoff for the SDKs (minor semver), can ship in 3 days.

priya: I'll add a weekly recurring alert summary to the observability channel so we catch regressions early.

sarah: Great. I'll own the public postmortem writeup and sync with legal/comms. ETA for public note: COB next Thursday. Thanks all. :rocket:

sarah: Reopen if we miss any owners or timelines.
